source_rationale: Current U05 v7 databases contain post-U04 business writes and fresh sessions. Original v4 source/export is retained historical evidence and cannot replace them.

snapshot_and_recovery.a: Fresh coordinated frozen U05 snapshot to independent formally migrated final receivers
snapshot_and_recovery.t0: Authenticated final pre-open T0; recovery restored and independently verified while final served; warm proof completed before recovery freeze
snapshot_and_recovery.t1: After actual final API writes, freeze and capture new full source snapshot
snapshot_and_recovery.delta: Authenticated PK-addressed before/after row delta from T0 to T1; strict before-image application to warm recovery
snapshot_and_recovery.verification: Full retained row/type/UUID/sequence/FK reconciliation against T1, followed by a fresh recovery credential epoch
snapshot_and_recovery.scope_limit: Observed local controlled migration and logical recovery while frozen source is readable; not a claim of arbitrary media-loss RPO0 or production PITR

credential_policy: Exclude all six credential tables from receivers; fresh JWT/client-secret/account-session boundary per activation. Never rewrite signed credentials.
external_callback_policy: Keep the existing uncoordinated external seed client DISABLED; no external RP requests or assumed owner confirmation.
effects_policy: No deployment/ZIP agent configured and task tables must be freshly observed empty. Retain notification records; do not re-publish old notifications or infer untouched external effects.
